Vendored hashing binaries: hash-wasm 4.12.0

Official maintainer repository: https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm
Exact package: https://registry.npmjs.org/hash-wasm/-/hash-wasm-4.12.0.tgz
Package SHA-512 integrity:
sha512-+/2B2rYLb48I/evdOIhP+K/DD2ca2fgBjp6O+GBEnCDk2e4rpeXIK8GvIyRPjTezgmWn9gmKwkQjjx6BtqDHVQ==

The .wasm files are the unchanged base64-decoded data fields of the respective
name:"xxhash64" and name:"blake3" objects in this exact package's
dist/xxhash64.umd.min.js and dist/blake3.umd.min.js. No crypto primitive was
rewritten or compiled locally. manifest.json pins byte counts and SHA-256:

xxhash64.wasm 2386 bytes
de1f937a9c1d82dc347dd6abb38833f73ef77bebe68495b2ca3c51b584df79be
blake3.wasm 11891 bytes
984b12e3b76a670fe58f43aa965658cdfefe0867f88c4935a292f68bdf3c55e1

Reproduce/verify after npm ci --ignore-scripts:
node scripts/check-extended-hash-assets.js
node scripts/check-extended-hash-assets.js --write
The write option reproduces only the already-pinned bytes. An upstream version
upgrade requires manual review of source, licenses, checksums and vectors.

Upstream C sources in the npm archive:
src/xxhash64.c, src/blake3.c, src/hash-wasm.h.
Upstream JavaScript API/wrapper sources:
lib/xxhash64.ts, lib/blake3.ts, lib/WASMInterface.ts.

xxhash64.c is Stephan Brumme's XXHash64 implementation based on Yann Collet's
algorithm description, modified for hash-wasm by Dani Biro. It is XXH64, not
XXH3-64. blake3.c derives from the BLAKE3 team's reference C implementation
(its embedded version string is 0.3.7), modified for hash-wasm by Dani Biro.
See LICENSE.txt and UPSTREAM-LICENSES.txt. Both sources are in the pinned npm
package; the JavaScript adapter is local project code, not upstream code.

The local adapter replaces only asynchronous WebAssembly compile/instantiate
with synchronous Module/Instance construction. Each input is copied in at most
16-KiB chunks, matching upstream MAIN_BUFFER_SIZE/MAX_HEAP. XXH64's eight seed
bytes are reset to zero before Hash_Init. BLAKE3 Hash_Init(0) selects unkeyed
mode and Hash_Final(32) selects its first 32 output bytes. No keys, contexts,
host imports, native addons, network access or build scripts are involved.

The npm package is a pinned development-only dependency for byte-for-byte
asset verification and comparisons against its public async and streaming API.
Production runs from these checked-in WASM files with Node >=22.14 only.
Independent expected results and 64-MiB verification are described in
scripts/fixtures/extended-hash-vectors.PROVENANCE.txt.
